title: Search, Inspect, and Download Data from ScienceDB
text: goal sciencedb provide user-friendly, programmatic R interface ScienceDB (Science Data Bank), global generalist data repository managed Computer Network Information Center (CNIC) Chinese Academy Sciences (CAS). core platform publishing, sharing, accessing scientific data China around world, ScienceDB holds vast, high-value datasets spanning multidisciplinary research domains. sciencedb bridges ecosystem R workflow allowing users search across 10,000 datasets keywords, inspect dataset metadata, batch-downloads files directly local environment smart file management.

A nationwide questionnaire survey was conducted among students of a university in Sichuan Province, China, from March 5 to March 10, 2024, using a convenience sampling method. The survey method was online and uniform. Specifically, respondents were asked to answer questions online by scanning the QR code of the questionnaire or clicking on the questionnaire link to open the online evaluation page. In order to ensure the quality of the survey data, we appointed corresponding instructors and suggested that they do a good job in organizing the questionnaire test, such as suggesting that they conduct a centralized assessment and do not forward the QR code or link to students at will; at the same time, it is recommended that they explain the questionnaire and test instructions to students before the unified test. title: Search ScienceDB Datasets by Keyword — sdb_search
Search ScienceDB Datasets by Keyword — sdb_search
text: keyword character string specifying search query topic (e.g., 'personality', 'economics'). Default 'NULL', returns top default results.

title: Search ScienceDB Datasets by Keyword — sdb_search
text: data frame containing following columns: Title English dataset title (falls back Chinese title English missing). Author Semicolon-separated list author names. Keyword Semicolon-separated list English keywords. Publish Publish date string. Doi Digital Object Identifier associated dataset. Taxonomy Semicolon-separated taxonomy categories. Language Dataset language code/string. Introduction Dataset abstract description. Access Access conditions (PUBLIC/RESTRICTED/EMBARGO). Views Total page view count. Downloads Total file download count. Cstr China Science Technology Resource identifier.
